p0.original: 关键问题：成年人面临哪些发展挑战
p0.en: Key issues: Development challenges for adults

p2.original: 在成年期，人们将完成一系列的转变。在此过程中，先天和后天因素继续相互作用，不同年龄的文化规范和最新技术相结合，以此提升成年人的生活质量并延长其寿命。
p2.en: In adulthood, people will complete a series of transformations. In this process, the innate and acquired factors continue to interact, combining cultural norms of different ages with the latest technologies, as a means of improving the quality of life of adults and extending their longevity.

p3.original: 从青春期向成年早期转变的标志是，个体做出了关于高等教育、职业和亲密关系等方面的决定。做出这些决定并不断调节自己以适应可能的结果是成年期的主要任务，因为是它们塑造了成年人的心理发展过程。但是发展并不止步于此。来自事业、家庭和朋友的持续压力，伴随着身体的不断成熟（和最终的衰退），为个体持续不断地带来新的发展挑战。不过，当今世界上，传统的年老化时钟已经向后调了，这实质上为成年期各个阶段的成年人“争取到了更多时间”。这场有关老龄化的革命是本阶段核心概念的关键要素：
p3.en: The shift from adolescence to early adulthood is marked by individual decisions on higher education, occupation and intimate relationships. These decisions are taken and their adaptation to the possible outcome is the main task of adulthood, as they shape the process of the psychological development of adults. But development is not going to go beyond that. The continuing pressure from causes, families and friends, accompanied by a steady physical maturity (and eventual decline), continues to bring new development challenges to individuals. In today's world, however, the traditional aging clock has been reversed, which in essence “takes more time” for adults at all stages of adulthood. This revolution on ageing is a key element of the core concept at this stage:

p4.original: 在成年期，人们将完成一系列的转变。在此过程中，先天和后天因素继续相互作用，不同年龄的文化规范和最新技术相结合，以此提升成年人的生活质量并延长其寿命。
p4.en: In adulthood, people will complete a series of transformations. In this process, the innate and acquired factors continue to interact, combining cultural norms of different ages with the latest technologies, as a means of improving the quality of life of adults and extending their longevity.

p5.original: 在我们更深入地研究成人期之前，我们需要关注核心概念中的几个要点。首先，从本章的前面部分你可能已经了解到阶段理论（描述人类发展的流行理论）往往犯了过度简化的错误。虽然主流的阶段理论（如皮亚杰、科尔伯格和埃里克森提出的那些理论）的主要发展任务和类别在很大程度上经受住了实证的检验，但是心理学家们现在认为，发展并不是以僵化的阶段形式出现的。它更像一个连续的过程，会有波动，会有爆发。换言之，阶段理论提出的发展内容可能是正确的，但是发展的时间进程可能比它们所认为的更加灵活。在整个生命周期中，这一点在成人发展上得到了最好体现。研究发现，健康成人从青年到中年到老年会经历一系列的转变。成功渡过这些转变需要个人反思和再调整，这些我们都将在这一部分进行讨论。
p5.en: Before we look more deeply at adulthood, we need to focus on several points in the core concept. First of all, you may have learned from the earlier part of this chapter that the theory of the stage (the popular theory that describes human development) often makes an oversimplified mistake. Although the main developmental tasks and categories of mainstream stage theory (such as those advanced by Piage, Kolberg and Eriksen) have to a large extent been tested by empirical evidence, psychologists now believe that development does not take the form of rigid stages. It's more like a continuous process, with fluctuations, with eruptions. In other words, the development content of the phase theory may be right, but the time-frame for development may be more flexible than they believe. This is best reflected in adult development throughout the life cycle. The study found that healthy adults experience a series of changes from youth to middle-aged to old age. Successfully overcoming these transformations requires personal reflection and readjustment, which we will all discuss in this section.

p6.original: 值得注意的第二点是西方世界中成人期的变化性质。得益于更好的健康保健和技术，人们比以往任何时候活得都长，并且晚年的健康状况更好。这反过来正在改变人们对寿命和什么年龄进入什么阶段的看法。越来越少的人仍然觉得，在20岁出头就必须结婚、安定下来，或者在65岁的时候就必须退休。我们正在见证一场老龄化“革命”的开始，它是由先天（更长的寿命）和后天（我们的文化适应这种变化的方式）共同引起的。
p6.en: The second point worth noting is the changing nature of adulthood in the Western world. Thanks to better health care and technology, people live longer than ever before and in later years. This, in turn, is changing perceptions of life expectancy and the age at which it is entering. Fewer people still feel that they have to marry, settle down at the age of 20 or retire at the age of 65. We are witnessing the beginning of an ageing “revolution”, which was brought about jointly by birth (longer longevity) and the day after tomorrow (the way our culture adapts to this change).

p7.original: 这场老龄化革命（revolution in aging）促使人们重新关注心理科学中有关成人发展的研究。虽然很多年来我们仅依赖基于临床观察的理论，但是我们现在已经积累了越来越多的实证研究。有趣的是，很多新研究支持了传统的临床理论——但是新研究也为21世纪的成年期发展过程提供了新的见解。为了了解这些发展变化，我们可以从人格开始讨论——我们从中会发现很多不同理论都具有惊人的一致性。
p7.en: This ageing revolution has led to a renewed focus on research on adult development in psychological science. Although we have relied for many years on theories based on clinical observation, we have now accumulated a growing body of empirical research. Interestingly, many new studies have supported traditional clinical theories — but they have also provided new insights into the development of adulthood in the twenty-first century. In order to understand these developments, we can begin with the question of personality — in which we find that many different theories are remarkably consistent.

p8.original: 弗洛伊德教导说，成人的发展是由两种基本需求驱动的：爱和工作。亚伯拉罕·马斯洛（Maslow，1970）认为，关键需求是爱和归属，一旦这一需求得到满足，我们的需求就会转为自尊和自我实现的需求。其他理论家将成年期的这些基本需求分为归属或社会接纳的需求、成就或胜任的需求，以及权力需求（McClelland，1975，1985；McClelland & Boyatzis，1982）。在埃里克森的理论中，成年早期和中期关注亲密关系和“繁衍”的需求。尽管所有这些理论都为健康的成年生活提供了重要线索，但它们的共同点是都承认人际关系需求。因为埃里克森对成人发展给出了最全面的解释，所以我们将使用他的理论作为我们的分析框架，阐明当代成人的发展过程。
p8.en: Freud teaches that adult development is driven by two basic needs: love and work. According to Abraham Maslow, 1970, the key demand is love and belonging, and once it is met, our needs will turn into the need for self-esteem and self-fulfilment. Other ideologues classify these basic needs as belonging to or socially accepted needs, achievements or competencies, as well as the need for power (McClelland, 1975, 1985); McClelland & Boyatsis, 1982. In Eriksen's theory, early and medium-term attention is paid to the need for intimate relationships and “reproduction”. While all these theories provide important clues for healthy adult life, they all share the common denominator of recognizing the need for interpersonal relationships. Because Eriksson has given the most comprehensive interpretation of adult development, we will use his theory as our analytical framework to illustrate the development process of contemporary adults.

p15.original: 描述成年早期的关键挑战。
p15.en: The key challenges of the early adulthood are described.

p16.original: 成年早期的发展任务是什么？也许对于20多岁的人来说，重要的问题是“什么时候自己开始成年了”。十几岁时，我们中的很多人都向往着到18岁时成为一个法定的大人而获得“自由”。但是心理上的成年期也是从18岁开始的吗？
p16.en: What is the development task of early adulthood? Perhaps for people in their 20s, the important question is “when they have grown up”. In our teens, many of us aspired to be “free” by the age of 18 as legal adults. But did the psychologically adult age start at the age of 18?

p18.original: 埃里克森提出，成年早期的挑战是和其他成人建立亲密关系（见表7-1）。他把亲密（intimacy）描述为对另一个人做出一个全面承诺——包括性、情绪和道德——的能力。做出亲密承诺需要对个人喜好做出妥协、承担责任，以及在个人隐私和独立上做出一些让步，但是这个承诺也为个人带来巨大回报。然而，为了获得亲密关系，个体必须解决对亲密的需求和对由亲密带来的伤害和风险的恐惧两者之间的冲突。不能成功解决这一危机将导致孤独，以及对通过有意义的方式与他人建立联结感到无能为力。
p18.en: Eriksen suggested that the challenge at an early stage of adulthood was to establish intimate relationships with other adults (see table 7-1). He described intimacy as the ability to make a full commitment to another person — including sex, emotion and morality. A close commitment requires compromise on individual preferences, accountability and some concessions on individual privacy and independence, but it also brings great rewards to individuals. In order to gain intimate relationships, however, individuals must address the conflict between the need for intimate relationships and the fear of harm and risk from intimate relationships. Failure to resolve this crisis successfully will lead to isolation and a sense of powerlessness to build meaningful links with others.

p19.original: 埃里克森认为，在能成功应对成人亲密关系的风险和收益之前，年轻人必须首先强化自我同一性（解决青春期的危机）。本质上，你必须首先知道你是谁，你的社会角色是什么，你才能对他人做出爱和共同生活的承诺。然而，埃里克森描述的从自我同一性到亲密关系这一顺序可能并没有准确地反映如今的现实生活。近年来的趋势是，年轻人会与他人婚前同居，但迟迟不愿与一个人签订建立终身亲密关系的契约。此外，现今许多人在努力处理亲密关系的同时，还在为自我同一性问题苦苦挣扎（如职业选择）。与埃里克森描述的那一代年轻人相比，21世纪的年轻人在生活中要面临更多的选择和更复杂的环境。
p19.en: Eriksen believes that young people must first strengthen their own identity (to address the adolescent crisis) before they can successfully cope with the risks and benefits of adult intimacy. In essence, you must first know who you are and what your social role is, so that you can make a commitment to love and live together. However, the sequence described by Eriksson, from self-impersonation to intimate relationships, may not accurately reflect the reality of today's life. In recent years, the trend has been for young people to live with others before marriage, but to be reluctant to enter into a contract with a person to establish a life-long intimate relationship. In addition, many people today struggle (e.g., career choices) for their own sexual identity while trying to deal with intimate relationships. Young people in the twenty-first century face more choices and more complex environments in their lives than the generation that Eriksen described.

p20.en: 7.12.2 Early start of the year: intermediate phase

p21.original: 心理学家杰弗瑞·简森·阿内特（Arnett，2000a，2001）认识到了当代人的成年期和前几代人的成年期之间的差异，提出了一个青春期到成年期的过渡阶段——成年初显期（emerging adulthood）。这一时期是从十几岁到二十多岁，很多工业化社会的个体都已经度过青春期，但是他们还不觉得自己是一个成年人。从前，结婚、第一个孩子的出生和职业生涯的建立等可见事件都是进入成年期的标记。如今年轻人将更多不可见的事件（如自己承担责任和独立做决定）作为成年的重要标志。大多数刚成年的人都报告说，他们只在走向自立的里程碑的过程中取得了部分进展（Arnett，1997）。
p21.en: The psychologist Jeffrey Jansen Arnett (Arnett, 2000a, 2001), aware of the differences between the adult age of the present generation and that of the previous generations, proposed a transition period between adolescence and adulthood — the beginning of the year (emerging early). This period, from the age of teens to the age of 20, has been spent in adolescence by individuals in many industrialized societies, but they do not feel that they are adults. Previously, such visible events as marriage, the birth of the first child and the establishment of a professional career were all signs of reaching adulthood. Today, young people use more invisible events (such as taking responsibility and making independent decisions) as important indicators of adulthood. The majority of the adult population reported that they had made only partial progress towards the milestones of self-reliance (Arnett, 1997).

p22.original: 传统上，年轻人会在20多岁时找到人生伴侣并且安顿下来养家糊口。如今，很多发达国家的年轻人要到30多岁才决定结婚。
p22.en: Traditionally, young people find a life partner in their late 20s and settle down to feed their families. Today, young people in many developed countries decide to marry in their late 30s.

p23.original: 成年初显期是个体在所有领域都进行探索和实验的时期。十几岁和二十多岁的年轻人会尝试各种不同类型的工作，探索不同的生活方式和世界观，并找出适合自己的心仪对象类型。和人生中的其他阶段相比，这一时期他们的学业追求、居住地选择和经济负担能力的可预测性更低。在这个时期，差不多半数的人会从家里搬出来，后来又搬回去，有60%的人会在高中毕业后的一年内开始大学生活，这其中只有一半的学生会在二十多岁完成4年或者更长时间的学业（Bianchi & Spain，1996；U.S. Bureau of the Census，2011）。在大学毕业生中，选择继续读研究生的人比前几代人要多（Mogelonsky，1996）。年轻人在这个时期比其他任何时期（包括青春期）都承担了更多风险。在这些年中，酒精和药物滥用、危险驾驶和无防护性行为的发生率达到高峰（Arnett，1992）。这些行为模式的出现可能是由于角色责任感的严重缺失、脱离父母监管的自由以及作为冲动行为调节器的前额皮层尚未发育完成等因素共同造成的。
p23.en: The beginning of the year was a period of exploration and experimentation by individuals in all fields. Young people in their teens and in their twenties try different types of work, explore different lifestyles and world views, and identify the types of objects that fit their hearts and minds. Their academic pursuit, choice of place of residence and financial affordability during this period are less predictable than at other stages of their lives. During this period, almost half of the population will move out of their homes and then back home, and 60 per cent will start university life within one year of high school graduation, and only half of the students will complete their studies in their late 20s for four years or more (Bianchi & Spain, 1996; U.S. Bueau of the Census, 2011). Among university graduates, more people choose to continue their graduate studies than in previous generations (Mogelonsky, 1996). Young people are more at risk at this time than at any other time, including adolescence. The incidence of alcohol and substance abuse, hazardous driving and unprotected sex peaks during these years (Arnett, 1992). These patterns of behaviour may be the result of a serious lack of responsibility for the role, freedom from parental custody and the fact that the pre-cortex, which is an impulse regulator, has not yet been developed.

p24.original: 那么，埃里克森确定的青春期和成年初显期的主要任务是否正确呢？大体上，他是正确的。虽然没有被人们广泛注意到，但他观察到，在工业化社会中，年轻人似乎很享受漫长的青春期，他们不断地实验各种角色身份。事实上，这正是阿内特的实验研究得到的结果。这一研究表明，到30岁时，大部分西方人才结婚生子，完成从学校到全职工作的转变，并且认为自己已经是一个成年人了。因此，大概到此时，他们才获得亲密关系，也就是埃里克森所描述的成年早期的主要发展任务。值得注意的是，现今年轻人也将亲密关系或个人关系视为幸福生活的关键（Arnett，2000b），虽然很多人承认，很难平衡亲密关系和自主这两种竞争性的需求。我们将看到，追求这两种需求间的最佳平衡将持续成为成年期后续阶段的特征。
p24.en: So is Eriksson right about the main tasks identified for adolescence and the beginning of the year? Basically, he's right. While not widely noted, he observed that in industrialized societies, young people seemed to enjoy a long period of adolescence and were constantly experimenting with different roles. In fact, this is the result of an experimental study by Arnett. This study shows that by the age of 30, most Westerners marry and have children, complete the transition from school to full-time work and consider themselves to be an adult. Thus, it is probably at this point that they will be given intimate relationships, which are the main developmental tasks of the early adulthood as described by Eriksson. It is worth noting that today young people also see intimate and personal relationships as key to a happy life (Arnett, 2000b), although many acknowledge that it is difficult to balance the competing demands of intimate and autonomous relationships. We will see that the pursuit of the best balance between these two needs will continue to characterize the subsequent stages of adulthood.

p25.en: 7.123 The way in which modern intimacy takes place

p26.original: 那么，如今年轻人如何获得亲密关系呢？虽然90%以上的人仍然会结婚，但是他们的婚姻可能不止一次。同样的模式也发生在同性恋的长期关系中——无论他们是否拥有合法婚姻（Knox & Schact，2008）。事实上，大约一半的美国婚姻以离婚告终（U.S.Bureau of the Census，2002）。此外，越来越多的伴侣正在同居而不是结婚（Doyle，2002b）。高离婚率可能部分是因为个体在没有解决自己的同一性之前就开始寻找亲密关系了。对彼此以及理想婚姻和家庭结构的不切实际的期望也会造成离婚（Cleek & Pearson，1985），我们的文化过分强调个人幸福，这也使离婚率上升。另一方面，有证据表明，现在配偶间的沟通和感情交流比前几代更好，那些掌握了良好沟通技巧的人减少了离婚的可能性（Caplow，1982；Markman & Notarius，1993）。
p26.en: So, how do young people get close relationships today? Although more than 90 per cent of the population still married, they may have married more than once. The same pattern also occurs in long-term relationships between homosexuals, regardless of whether they have a legal marriage (Knox & Schact, 2008). In fact, about half of American marriages end in divorce (U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2002). In addition, more and more partners are living together rather than getting married (Doyle, 2002b). The high divorce rate may be due in part to the fact that an individual has started to seek intimate relationships without addressing his/her own identity. Unrealistic expectations of each other and of the ideal marriage and family structure also result in divorce (Cleek & Pearson, 1985), and our culture overemphasizes personal happiness, which also increases divorce rates. On the other hand, there is evidence that communication and emotional communication between spouses is now better than in previous generations, and that those who have good communication skills have reduced the likelihood of divorce (Caplow, 1982); Markman & Notarius, 1993.

p27.original: 21世纪，婚姻伴侣更可能将彼此视为搭档和朋友，而不太可能受社会对一个“丈夫”或“妻子”的期望的束缚。同伴婚姻（peer marriage）中的伴侣以最适合他们关系的方式进行交流和互相帮助，而不会采用传统的观念（男人是“老板”，或者妻子应该做“女人的事”）（Schwartz，1994）。公平且令人满意的关系的关键是沟通，双方可以开诚布公地表达自己的希望和恐惧（Klagsbrun，1985）。关于良好沟通如何维系人际关系的知识如雨后春笋般涌现，这些知识有助于我们的社会文化将婚姻视为一项有价值的投资，并且将婚姻咨询作为维系婚姻的一种有益选项（Gottman，1994；Notarius，1996）。简言之，维系关系不再被视为在建立亲密关系中“自然而然”就会掌握的技能。相反，亲密关系被视为一生都要进行的工作——值得投入时间和精力，个体可以通过更加清晰的自我认知、有效的冲突解决和良好的沟通来提升它的质量。
p27.en: In the twenty-first century, marital partners are more likely to see each other as partners and friends than to be bound by society's expectations of a “husband” or “wife”. Partners in peer marriages communicate and help each other in the most appropriate way for their relationship, rather than using the traditional notion that a man is the “boss” or that a wife should do “women's business” (Schwartz, 1994). The key to a fair and satisfactory relationship is communication, in which both sides can express their hopes and fears openly and openly (Klagsbrun, 1985). Knowledge of how good communication sustains interpersonal relations has emerged as a springing spring, which has helped our societies and cultures to view marriage as a valuable investment and to use marriage counselling as a useful option for maintaining marriage (Gottman, 1994); Notarius, 1996. In short, maintenance relationships are no longer seen as skills that can be acquired “naturally” in establishing intimate relationships. On the contrary, intimacy is seen as a lifelong undertaking — worth investing time and energy, and individuals can improve their quality through clearer self-awareness, effective conflict resolution and good communication.

p28.original: 哪些因素会影响良好的沟通和有效的冲突解决呢？令人惊讶的是，配偶间冲突的频率和他们关系的健康程度之间不存在相关关系：经常吵架的夫妻的离婚率并没有比很少起冲突的夫妻高。起关键作用的是积极互动和消极互动之间的比例，研究发现最佳比例是5:1（Gottman，1995）。换句话说，不管在婚内会发生多少冲突，只要夫妻间积极互动的次数是消极互动的5倍，那么他们的婚姻就是健康的。并且，“积极互动”不一定是浪漫的周末或精心安排的约会，很多小事如一个微笑、一个吻、一声赞美或一句感谢，也可以计算在内。（可想而知，一个浪漫的长周末或一次美好的约会会有很多的积极互动。）当然，消极互动也可能是一些小事——但是会给人带来很大的伤害——包括充满敌意的讽刺、辱骂、翻白眼或摔门等行为。通过维持5∶1的积极和消极互动比例，夫妻双方建立了一个支持性基础，这可以说是增强了亲密关系的免疫系统。因此，当冲突发生时，双方就很少将事情看作针对个人的或者马上做出防备举动，这将使他们把注意力放在问题解决上而非互相指责上。表7-6就是一个帮你获得5∶1比率的建议列表。
p28.en: What factors influence good communication and effective conflict resolution? Surprisingly, there is no correlation between the frequency of conflict between spouses and the health of their relationship: divorce rates are no higher for couples who often argue than for couples who have few conflicts. The ratio between active and negative interactions is critical, and the study found that the optimal ratio was 5:1 (Gottman, 1995). In other words, regardless of the number of conflicts that may occur within marriage, if the number of active interactions between spouses is five times the number of negative interactions, then their marriage is healthy. Moreover, “active interaction” is not necessarily a romantic weekend or a carefully scheduled date, and many small things can be counted as a smile, a kiss, a compliment or a word of gratitude. (It is conceivable that there will be a lot of positive interaction between a romantic weekend or a good date. Of course, negative interaction can also be minor — but it can cause great harm — including hostile sarcasm, verbal abuse, white eye flips or door falls. By maintaining the ratio of active and negative interactions of 5:1, couples have established a supportive base, which can be said to strengthen the immune system for intimate relationships. Thus, when a conflict occurs, the parties rarely regard it as personal or immediately defensive, which would allow them to focus on the solution of the problem rather than on mutual accusations. Tables 7-6 are a suggested list of rates that help you to get a 5:1.

p31.original: 7.13 成年中期的挑战：复杂性和繁衍
p31.en: 7.13 The challenge in the medium term for adulthood: complexity and reproduction

p33.original: 解释繁衍和复杂性如何提升成年中期的健康生活。
p33.en: Explain how reproduction and complexity can enhance healthy lives in the middle of adulthood.

p34.original: 对很多人来说，中年这个概念让人想起可怕的中年危机和生日贺卡上那句开玩笑的“越过山丘”（over the hill）的话[8]。然而，与人们对中年的刻板印象相反，研究发现中年期是很多方面发展的巅峰期。在认知上，这个年龄段的很多成年人在结合和整合各种不同的思维方式方面，已经发展出了很多的技能，包括反思、分析和辩证推理（比较和评估互相矛盾的观点的能力；Baltes & Staudinger，1993；King & Kitchener，1994）。他们还擅长整合自己的认知和情绪，从而能够更加深思熟虑、更加从容不迫地应对压力事件（Diehl et al.，1996）。
p34.en: For many, the concept of middle-aged is reminiscent of the “over the hill” joke on the terrible middle-aged crisis and birthday cards. However, contrary to stereotypes, the study found that the mid-year period was the culmination of many developments. (b) The cognitive development of skills in integrating and integrating different ways of thinking among many adults of this age group, including the ability to reflect, analyse and justify reasoning (comparison and assessment of conflicting views); Baltes & Staudinger, 1993; King & Kitchener, 1994. They are also well placed to integrate their own perceptions and emotions so that they can respond to stress events with greater thought and tolerance (Diehl et al., 1996).

p35.original: 综合来看，这些技能使得中年人能够兼顾各种自己在意的事情，通常包括工作、家庭、社区、爱好和自我保健等。并且，事实上，这种繁忙复杂的生活方式是如今健康中年人的生活特点。心理学家罗莎琳德·巴尼特和珍妮特·海德（Barnett & Hyde，2001）指出，随着接受专业培训的女性比例达到了前所未有的水平，在当今社会，双职工家庭已经是常态。与这种趋势同时发生的是，在工作角色和家庭角色之间的流动性增大：男性不再把自己仅仅定义为工作者和家庭的顶梁柱，而女性也不再仅仅把自己定义为妻子和母亲。对于大多数人来说，这种个人角色的扩展为他们提供了一个更大的社会支持网络，并提升了他们的幸福感。除了个人角色的多样性增加之外，今天的中年人比从前的人享受到了在人际关系、资源和生活方式上的更多的多样性（Moen & Wethington，1999）。这种复杂性与幸福感有关，复杂的个体将生活视为一系列的挑战，充满了多样性，可以促进个人成长（Ryff & Heincke，1983）。并且，总体而言，年过50岁的成年人比年轻人更加幸福，压力和烦恼也更少（Stone et al.，2010）。
p35.en: Taken together, these skills enable middle-aged people to balance their own concerns, usually including work, family, community, hobby and self-care. Moreover, in fact, this busy and complex lifestyle is a feature of the lives of healthy middle-aged people today. Psychologist Rosalynd Barnett and Janet Hyde (Barnett & Hyde, 2001) noted that, with the unprecedented percentage of women in professional training, dual-career families are now normal in society. This trend has been accompanied by increased mobility between work and family roles: men no longer define themselves as mere pillars of work and family, nor do women define themselves as mere wives and mothers. For most people, this expansion of personal roles provides them with a larger network of social support and enhances their sense of well-being. In addition to the increased diversity of individual roles, today's middle-aged people enjoy more diversity in interpersonal relationships, resources and lifestyles than before (Moen & Wethington, 1999). This complexity is linked to happiness, with complex individuals viewing life as a series of challenges, filled with diversity that can foster individual growth (Ryff & Heincke, 1983). Moreover, adults over 50 years of age are generally happier than young people, with less stress and distress (Stone et al., 2010).

p37.original: 在埃里克森看来，繁衍（generativity）是成年中期的主要发展任务。对于那些成功应对了早期自我同一性和亲密关系挑战的人来说，繁衍为他们提供了一个机会，可以让他们为家庭、工作、社会和后代做出有意义的、长远的贡献。因此，处于这个阶段的人会扩大自己的注意范围，不仅关注自己和伴侣，还会抚养子女、做社区志愿者，或者以某些其他方式抚养下一代。研究证实，有较强生育意愿的成年人会有更高的生活满意度（McAdams et al.，1993）。与此相反，那些没有解决早期自我同一性和亲密关系危机的人可能会经历一场“中年危机”。这些人会质疑过去的选择，变得愤世嫉俗、停滞不前，或者走向另一个极端，变得自我放纵、不顾后果。好消息是——再次与人们对中年的刻板印象相反——大多数人并不会经历中年危机。非但如此，当子女离家时，中年人会变得抑郁并失去方向，这种说法也未被证实（Clay，2003a，2003b）。
p37.en: In Eriksen's view, reproduction is the main development task in the medium term. For those who have successfully responded to the challenges of early self-harmonic and intimate relationships, reproduction offers them an opportunity to make a meaningful and long-term contribution to the family, work, society and future generations. As a result, people at this stage expand their focus not only on themselves and their partners, but also on raising children, volunteering in the community or raising the next generation in some other way. Research has confirmed that adults who have a stronger will to bear children have higher levels of satisfaction (McAdams et al., 1993). On the contrary, those who fail to address early crises of self-identification and intimacy may experience a “mid-life crisis”. These people would question the choices of the past, become cynical, stagnating, or go to another extreme, become self-excusable and reckless. The good news is — again, contrary to stereotypes — that most people do not experience middle-aged crises. In addition, it has not been confirmed that when children leave their homes, middle-aged people become depressed and lose their direction (Clay, 2003a, 2003b).

p39.original: 大多数成年人在中年时都会经历一次转变（transition），他们将重新定义或转换自己的人生角色。事实上，有证据表明，成年生活的特点就是一系列的转变，从进入成年期的转变开始，可能每15年到20年就会发生一次（Levinson，1986；Sugarman，2001）。成功的转变通常会包含一段高度自我反省的时期，包括重新评估自己当前的角色，探索能够带来全新意义感的可能性，以及决定放弃旧的角色并致力于新的角色。转变可能包含了某些可以预见的事件，如结婚、生子、退休，也包括一些不可预期的事件，如突如其来的疾病、分手或失去工作或爱人。此外，预期会发生但是没有发生的事件也会推动转变的发生。例如，没有得到工作晋升的机会，或者想要孩子但是没有生育，等等。最后，转变也可能是渐进的过程，就像一段关系或工作随着时间会变得越来越乏味，或者一个人变得越来越自信：无论如何，在某一时刻，个体都会意识到一个关键性的差异，这会促使他进入转变期。
p39.en: Most adults experience a transition in their middle years, which will redefine or change their roles in life. In fact, there is evidence that adult life is characterized by a series of transformations, which may occur every 15 to 20 years from the beginning of the transition to adulthood (Levinson, 1986); Sugarman, 2001. Successful transformation usually involves a period of high self-reflection, including re-evaluation of their current roles, exploration of possibilities for bringing a new sense of meaning, and decisions to abandon old roles and commit to new ones. The transition may include certain foreseeable events, such as marriage, childbirth, retirement, and unforeseen events, such as sudden illness, break-up or loss of work or love. In addition, the expected but non-existent events will also drive change. For example, there is no opportunity for promotion at work, or for wanting to have children but not having children, etc. Finally, transformation can also be gradual, as a relationship or work becomes more boring over time, or a person becomes more confident: at any given moment, an individual becomes aware of a critical difference, which will drive him into a transition period.

p40.original: 迎接新的挑战是成功度过成年转变期的关键之一。这位女士在52岁时获得了基础教育硕士学位。
p40.en: Meeting new challenges is one of the keys to a successful transition through adulthood. At age 52, the woman received a master's degree in basic education.

p41.original: 鉴于我们的身体、认知和情绪能力——以及社会环境——在我们的一生中都会不断演化和改变，因此转变只是我们对内外部世界变化的一种自然反应。越来越多的证据表明，最长寿、最健康的成年人是那些成功度过了这些转变并从中重新找到生活的意义感和热情的人（Levinson，1978，1996；Ryff & Heidrich，1997）。有趣的是，有时转变可能会让个体重返埃里克森所说的某个早期阶段。例如，个体同一性的重组或亲密关系的转换等。而且，鉴于我们对复杂性的了解，我们可以预测复杂的个体——他们以积极、挑战和成长为导向——更有可能经历成功的转变。
p41.en: Given that our physical, cognitive and emotional abilities — and the social environment — will evolve and change over our lifetime, transformation is only a natural response to changes in the internal and external worlds. There is growing evidence that the longest and most healthy adults are those who have successfully survived these transformations and rediscovered the sense of meaning and passion of life (Levinson, 1978, 1996); Ryff & Heidrich, 1997. Interestingly, sometimes a change may bring the individual back to some early stage as Ericson said. For example, individual homogenous reorganization or the transformation of intimate relationships. Moreover, given our knowledge of complexity, we can predict that complex individuals — who are guided by positive, challenging and growing growth — are more likely to experience successful transformations.

p42.original: 总而言之，如今西方社会的成年中期的现实情况，与某些人头脑中存在的“越过山丘，开始走下坡路”的刻板印象相去甚远。许多中年人是充满精力的、勇往直前的个体，他们为世界做出了有意义的贡献，并在爱情、工作和个人成长方面享有众多机会。而且，似乎是繁衍和复杂性推动了这一成年中期的健康模式的达成。
p42.en: In sum, the reality of the mid-term age of Western society today is far from the stereotypes of some people who “go over the hill and start to go down the slope”. Many middle-aged people are energetic, courageous individuals who have made a meaningful contribution to the world and have many opportunities for love, work and personal growth. Moreover, it appears that reproduction and complexity have contributed to the achievement of this medium-term health model for adults.

p43.original: 7.14 成年晚期：开始整合的年纪
p43.en: 7.14 Late adulthood: age at which integration begins

p45.original: 讨论成年晚期发生的典型变化。
p45.en: It discusses typical changes that occur in the later stages of adulthood.

p46.original: 20世纪初，只有3%的美国人年龄超过65岁。100年后的今天，这个数字是13%。随着婴儿潮一代在接下来的几年开始进入这个年纪，届时将会有接近四分之一的人口超过65岁。
p46.en: At the beginning of the twentieth century, only 3 per cent of Americans were over 65 years old. Today, 100 years later, that figure is 13 per cent. As the baby boom generation begins to reach that age in the coming years, nearly a quarter of the population will be over 65 years of age.

p47.original: 到2030年，我们将见证人口结构的深刻变化（人口特征的变化）。到那时，将会有8000万美国人超过60岁。这将是有史以来第一次60岁以上的人口数量超过20岁以下的人口数量。这代表着对以前所有人口统计数据的巨大逆转，并且可能会显著偏离现今以青年为导向的文化（Pifer & Bronte，1986）。可能的变化包括：在养老院中，有文身和身体穿孔的人将越来越常见，而支付社会保险和医疗账单的人则越来越少。
p47.en: By 2030, we will have witnessed a profound change in the demographic structure (change in demographic characteristics). By then, 80 million Americans will be over 60. This will be the first time in history that the number of people over the age of 60 exceeds that of those under 20. This represents a significant reversal of all previous demographic statistics and could significantly deviate from the present-day youth-oriented culture (Piffer & Bronte, 1986). Possible changes include that persons with tattoos and body perforations will become more common in old-age homes, while fewer will pay social insurance and medical bills.

p48.original: 随着我们的社会中年龄分布剧变的临近，了解年老化的本质和老年人的能力与需求，变得比以往任何时候都更加重要（Roush，1996）。并且，从个人角度来说，这可能有助于你了解你的父母和祖父母可能会面临的发展挑战，以及预期你自己在生命的最后一个阶段可能会经历什么。
p48.en: As the age distribution in our societies approaches, it is more important than ever to understand the nature of ageing and the capacities and needs of older persons (Roush, 1996). And, from a personal perspective, this may help you to understand the development challenges that your parents and grandparents may face and what you may expect to experience in the last phase of your life.

p49.original: 晚年生活和过去不一样了。体育锻炼可以延长寿命，增进健康，即使一个人从80岁开始锻炼也是有益的。它也会提高人的认知功能，增加生活满意度。
p49.en: Life is different from the past. Physical exercise can prolong life and improve health, even if a person can exercise from the age of 80. It also enhances the cognitive function of people and their satisfaction with life.

p50.original: 从生物学角度来看，年老化通常意味着衰退：能量储备减少，细胞组织运行效率降低。然而，从认知角度来看，年老化不再是衰退的同义词（Qualls & Abeles，2000）。许多能力，包括专家技能和某些记忆能力，实际上会随年龄而提高（Azar，1996；Krampe & Ericsson，1996）。如果人的大脑始终保持开放和活跃，那么一生积累的经验最终会变成智慧。事实上，活动——无论是身体上的、社会-情绪的，还是认知上的——看起来都是健康年老化的关键：“用进废退！”这句话可以应用在晚年生活的很多方面。很多年老化理论都是平衡或权衡模型：老年人可能会失去能量储备，但是他们获得了控制情绪体验的能力，从而能够节约能量（Baltes，1987）。我们对年老化的许多负面假设与我们的文化价值观相关：在那些尊重长辈的文化中，人们对年老化有非常不同的看法和预期。年老化的任务是什么，我们在晚年将面临哪些机遇和限制？
p50.en: From a biological point of view, age ageing usually means decline: less energy reserves and less efficient functioning of cell tissue. However, from a cognitive point of view, ageing is no longer synonymous with recession (Qualls & Abeles, 2000). Many competencies, including specialist skills and some memory skills, will actually increase with age (Azar, 1996); Krampe & Ericsson, 1996. If the human brain remains open and active, the experience accumulated over the course of a lifetime will eventually turn into wisdom. In fact, activity, whether physical, social, emotional or cognitive, seems to be the key to healthy ageing: “Put it down! This sentence can be applied to many aspects of later life. Many ageing theories are balancing or weighing models: older persons may lose their energy reserves, but they acquire the ability to control emotional experiences and thus save energy (Baltes, 1987). Many of our negative assumptions about ageing are linked to our cultural values: in cultures that respect elders, there are very different views and expectations about ageing. What are the tasks of ageing, and what are the opportunities and constraints that we will face in our later years?

p52.original: 根据埃里克森的理论，在成年晚期，人们越来越意识到自己终将一死，意识到自己身体、行为以及社会角色的变化，这些意识构成了成年晚期的主要挑战。埃里克森把这个阶段的危机称为自我整合对绝望。自我整合（ego-integrity）这个维度的达成，包括能够毫无遗憾地回顾一生并且享受圆满的感觉。它要求个体能时时反思过去的好与坏，能够欣赏那些做得好的，也能够接受那些不够好的。目前为止，你知道埃里克森相信先前的危机必须成功得到解决才能够接受下一个挑战，所以你可能在思考一个发展良好的自我同一性、一个有意义的亲密关系和一种为下一代做贡献的感觉，可能会促进这种反思和接纳。然而，对于那些没有很好解决先前危机的个体来说，抱负可能仍未实现，这些人可能会体验到无用、绝望和辛酸。可悲的是，他们一般无法在这个人生的最后发展阶段成功地解决这个危机。
p52.en: According to Eriksen's theory, in the later stages of adulthood, there is a growing awareness that one will eventually die and that changes in one's body, behaviour and role in society constitute the main challenges in the later stages of adulthood. Eriksen called this stage of crisis self-integration despair. The achievement of the dimension of self-integration includes the ability to look back without regret and enjoy a sense of happiness. It requires individuals to reflect at times on the good and bad of the past, to appreciate what has done well and to accept what is not good enough. So far, you know that Eriksson believes that the previous crisis must be successfully resolved to accept the next challenge, so you may think about a well-developed self-sameness, a meaningful intimacy and a sense of contributing to the next generation, which may facilitate such reflection and acceptance. However, for individuals who did not resolve previous crises well, ambitions may still be unfulfilled, and they may experience useless, desperate and bitterness. Sadly, they are generally unable to successfully resolve the crisis at the final stage of their lives.

p54.original: 随着年龄增长出现的一些最明显的变化会影响人们的外表和身体能力。随着我们变老，我们可以预见我们的皮肤会出现皱纹，我们的头发会变得稀疏和花白，我们的身高会下降2.5厘米到5厘米。我们的心肺功能会下降，这降低了我们的体力。我们也会发现，我们的某些感觉变得迟钝。然而，越来越现代的生活，让老年人可以通过各种方式控制自己的身体，从而减缓一些功能的退化，尽管这些退化长期以来被认为是不可避免的。成功年老化需要将个体潜能和现实局限两方面的内容纳入考虑（Baltes，1993）。
p54.en: Some of the most visible changes as age increases affect the appearance and physical capacity of people. As we age, we can predict wrinkles in our skins, thinner hair and white hair, and two and a half centimetres to five centimetres in height. Our CPR is going down, which is going to reduce our strength. And we'll find that some of our feelings have become retarded. However, increasingly modern life allows older persons to control their own bodies in various ways, thereby slowing down some functional degradation, which has long been considered inevitable. Successful ageing requires consideration of both individual potential and realistic limitations (Baltes, 1993).

p55.original: 老年人对自己身体的老化可以有多大程度的影响呢？持续的（甚至是刚刚开始的）体育锻炼有助于延缓一些与年老化有关的身体机能衰退。步行或游泳等有氧训练可以提高心血管功能，力量训练可以改善血流，提升肌肉含量，这些反过来又可以改善身体姿态、平衡能力和身体应付日常活动的能力（如超市购物和园艺）。甚至那些久坐不动的老年人从80岁才开始锻炼，也能在身体上、情绪上，甚至认知能力上获益。定期锻炼可以改善大脑的供血和供氧，这些反过来又可以减少脑细胞的退化，增强注意力（Colcombe et al.，2004）。还有证据显示，运动可以降低阿尔茨海默病和其他脑部疾病的发病率（Marx，2005）。
p55.en: How much influence can older persons have on the ageing of their bodies? Continuing (even at the beginning) physical exercise has helped to slow down some of the physical decline associated with ageing. Aerobic training, such as walking or swimming, improves cardiovascular functions, and force training improves blood flow and muscle content, which in turn improves body posture, balancing abilities and body ability to cope with day-to-day activities (e.g. supermarket shopping and gardening). Even older persons who have been sitting for a long time can benefit physically, emotionally, and even cognitively from exercising from the age of 80. Regular exercise improves brain blood and oxygen supply, which in turn reduces brain cell degradation and increases attention (Colcombe et al., 2004). There is also evidence that sport can reduce the incidence of Alzheimer's disease and other brain diseases (Marx, 2005).

p56.original: 与西方社会的刻板印象相反，一半以上的老人在70多岁仍然有性生活。更重要的是，研究显示，性满足与心理敏锐度有关。
p56.en: Contrary to the stereotypes of Western societies, more than half of the elderly still have sex in their 70s. More importantly, research shows that sexual satisfaction is associated with psychological sensitivity.

p57.original: 在西方文化中，关于年老化的另一个误区是老年人不能也不应该有性生活。恪守这种观念才是阻止老年人获得满意性生活的障碍，这比身体限制的影响更大。虽然频率和欲望有所下降，但是无论男性或女性，都不存在性欲和性高潮停止的确切年龄。（现在尤其如此，因为大肆宣传的伟哥等药物已经改善了数百万老年男性的勃起功能。）虽然在成年晚期，性失去了生育功能，但是它没有失去获得快乐的能力。定期性生活可以促进健康年老化，因为它提供了性唤起、有氧活动、幻想和社交互动（Ornstein & Sobel，1989）。经验和创造力可以弥补身体变化或体力下降。
p57.en: In Western cultures, another area of error with regard to ageing is that older persons cannot and should not have sex. Adherence to this perception is the barrier preventing older persons from having a satisfying sexual life, which has a greater impact than physical constraints. Although the frequency and desire have decreased, there is no precise age at which sexual lust and orgasms are stopped, whether male or female. (This is particularly true now, as drugs such as Viagra, which are widely publicized, have improved the erection function of millions of older men. Although in the later stages of adulthood, the sex lost its reproductive function, it did not lose its ability to be happy. Regular sexual life can promote healthy ageing because it provides sexual agitation, aerobic activity, fantasy and social interaction (Ornstein & Sobel, 1989). Experience and creativity can make up for physical changes or reduced physical strength.

p59.original: 老年人经常担心衰老会不可避免地伴随着心理能力的下降。这种担心有道理吗？随着年龄增长，大脑的某些部分，特别是前额皮层，重量会减少，但是没有证据显示，这必然会导致健康成年人一般心理能力的降低。一方面，在需要想象力的任务中，如需要生动表象策略来帮助记忆的任务，记忆会随年龄下降（Baltes & Kliegl，1992）。到了七八十岁的时候，人们获取信息的速度变慢了。但是另一方面，正常人下降的程度可能没有大众想得那么严重（Helmuth，2003c）。脑成像的研究显示，老年人的大脑通过以不同的方式加工信息使大脑更多区域参与加工来弥补其功能的下降（Cabeza，2002；Helmuth，2002）。并且，正如体育锻炼可以提升身体健康一样，心智运动可以使老年人的大脑更有效地工作。此外，有一些能力会随年龄而加强。例如，老年人的语言表达和社交能力一贯比年轻人更好。并且，在技巧性很高的表演方面，音乐家的表现说明即使到90多岁了他们的演奏技巧仍然能有所提高（Krampe & Ericsson，1996）。心理学家正在探索与年龄相关的智慧增益，例如，在实践知识和生活经验中的专长（Baltes，1990）。最后，我们注意到，不断有证据表明，体育锻炼可以改善老年人的学习、记忆和其他认知功能，近期的研究还表明，食用欧米伽脂肪酸与体育锻炼相结合，可以快速地对脑功能和大脑可塑性产生成效（Chodzko-Zajko et al.，2009；van Praag，2009）。因此，信息已经很明确了：老年人的生活越积极，他们就越有可能享受更好的认知能力和更健康的身体。
p59.en: Older persons often fear that ageing will inevitably be accompanied by a decline in mental capacity. Is that a legitimate fear? As age increases, certain parts of the brain, especially the front cortex, decrease in weight, but there is no evidence that this necessarily leads to a reduction in the general mental capacity of healthy adults. On the one hand, in missions that require imagination, memory declines with age, when it requires a graphic graphic strategy to help with memory (Baltes & Kliegl, 1992). By the age of 70 and 80, people were slower to get information. On the other hand, normal people may fall less seriously than the general public would expect (Helmuth, 2003c). Studies of brain imaging show that older people's brain compensates for the decline in its functioning by processing information in different ways to involve more regions of the brain in processing (Cabeza, 2002); Helmuth, 2002. Moreover, just as physical exercise enhances physical health, mental exercise enables older persons to work more effectively in their brains. In addition, there are a number of capacities that can be strengthened with age. For example, older persons have always had better linguistic and social skills than younger people. Moreover, in terms of highly skilled performances, musicians have shown that their performance skills can be improved even when they are in their 90s (Krampe & Ericsson, 1996). Psychologists are exploring age-related wisdom gains, such as expertise in practical knowledge and life experience (Baltes, 1990). Finally, we note that there is continuing evidence that physical exercise improves the learning, memory and other cognitive functions of older persons, and recent studies have shown that the combination of Omega fat acid consumption and physical exercise can produce rapid results in brain function and brain plasticity (Chodzko-Zajko et al., 2009); #Van Praag, 2009. Thus, the message is clear: the more active the lives of older persons, the more likely they are to enjoy better cognitive abilities and healthier bodies.

p60.original: 记忆会变得怎么样呢？老年人常常抱怨他们记东西的能力不如从前了。大部分与年龄相关的记忆困难发生在与加工和存储新信息有关的脑区（Poon，1985），年老化似乎并没有影响对很早以前存储的知识或事件的提取。因此，老年人可能不得不问上好几遍，才能记住一个新认识的人的名字，但是他们在回忆老朋友的名字时没有问题。一个更重要的问题是，人们会根据健忘者的年龄给出健忘的不同解释。在这种双重标准之下，我们可能会把年轻人的记忆问题归因于他不够努力，而把老年人的记忆问题归为能力丧失（Parr & Siegert，1993）。因此我们会掉入证实性偏差的陷阱：如果我们认为老年人更健忘，当一个老人忘记事情的时候，我们会注意到并记住这个事情，然后将之归因为年龄原因，而当一个年轻人忘记事情的时候，我们会忽视它或者将之归为情境原因。
p60.en: What happens to memories? Older persons often complain that they are less able to remember. Most of the age-related memory difficulties occur in the brain region (Poon, 1985) associated with processing and storing new information, and age ageing does not seem to affect the extraction of knowledge or events stored long ago. As a result, older persons may have to ask several times to remember the names of a new acquaintance, but they have no problems remembering the names of their old friends. A more important issue is that people give different interpretations of memory according to the age of the forgetner. Under this double standard, we may attribute the memory of young people to a lack of effort, while the memory of older persons is classified as incapacity (Parr & Siegert, 1993). So we fall into a trap of proven bias: if we think that older people are more forgetful, when an old person forgets, we notice and remember it, and then we attribute it to age, and when a young person forgets it, we ignore it or we attribute it to circumstances.

p61.original: 对于老年人和爱他们的人来说，最令人担忧的是阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease），一种大脑退行性疾病，它会使人的思维能力下降，出现记忆问题，并最终导致死亡。据估计，阿尔茨海默病在65岁以上人群中的发病率约为10%，随后发病率会随年龄持续上升，到85岁以上时，这个数字会增长为50%（National Institute on Aging，2004）。阿尔茨海默病的早期症状之一是记忆问题，这使得很多老年人在不能回忆起某个名字或某件事时会变得很焦虑——这是他们年轻时根本不会考虑的一个问题。这是一种让人感到特别恐惧的疾病，因为它会让人变得无助，剥夺他们获取新记忆的能力，并使他们忘记自己所爱的人。然而，有关阿尔茨海默病研究的新进展，为我们理解和治疗这种严重疾病提供了一些新思路。事实上，一些新的测试可以非常精确地诊断阿尔茨海默病——甚至在症状出现之前（DeMeyer et al.，2010）。虽然目前尚未找到治疗方法，但现在通过早期诊断和治疗可以延缓疾病的进程，最终提升阿尔茨海默病患者的生命质量。
p61.en: For the elderly and those who love them, the most worrying is the Alzheimer's disease, a brain-retarded disease that reduces human mental capacity, raises memory problems and eventually leads to death. It is estimated that the incidence of Alzheimer's disease among persons over 65 years of age is about 10 per cent, and that the incidence will subsequently increase steadily with age, to 50 per cent by the time the disease reaches 85 years of age (National Institute on Aging, 2004). One of the early symptoms of Alzheimer's is memory problems, which makes many older persons anxious when they cannot remember a name or something — a problem that they would not have considered at all when they were young. It is a disease of particular fear, because it can make people helpless, deprive them of the ability to acquire new memories and make them forget who they love. However, new developments in the study of Alzheimer's disease provide us with some new ideas for understanding and treating this serious disease. Indeed, some new tests can be very precise in diagnosing Alzheimer's disease - even before the symptoms appear (DeMeyer et al., 2010). Although treatment has not yet been found, it is now possible to delay the process of disease through early diagnosis and treatment, ultimately improving the quality of life of persons with Alzheimer's disease.

p63.original: 对老年人的社会和情绪状态也充斥着误解和刻板印象，人们常认为老年人脾气暴躁、性格孤僻。虽然长寿的悲剧之一确实是要目睹亲友的离去，但是研究发现老年人大多保持了一种健康的情绪状态和良好的社会关系。美国斯坦福大学（Stanford University）的教授劳拉·卡斯滕森（Laura Carstensen）指出，随着人们的年龄增长，他们倾向于进行选择性社交（selective social interaction），只与那些能带来身体和情绪能量最大回报的人保持联系（Carstensen，1987，1991；Lang & Carstensen，1994）。维持单一的亲密关系就能显著提升个人的健康水平，就像与心爱的宠物生活在一起一样（Siegel，1990）。
p63.en: The social and emotional state of older persons is also marked by misunderstandings and stereotypes, and older persons are often perceived to be violent and isolated. While it is true that one of the tragedies of longevity is to witness the departure of relatives and friends, research has found that older persons mostly maintain a healthy emotional state and good social relations. Laura Carstensen, Professor of Stanford University, United States, stated that, as people grow older, they tend to engage in selective social integration, only to contact those who can bring the greatest return on physical and emotional energy (Carstensen, 1987, 1991); Lang & Carstensen, 1994. Maintaining a single intimate relationship can significantly improve an individual's health, as if living with a beloved pet (Siegel, 1990).

p64.original: 老年人似乎也受益于他们的情绪系统，在某些方面，他们的情绪系统会随年龄变大而变得更加敏锐。一项最近的研究发现，当观看悲剧电影时，相比中年人和年轻人，老年人感到更加悲伤（Seider et al.，2010）。然而，老年人也会感受到比年轻人更多的积极情绪和更少的消极情绪（Mroczek，2001）。我们如何解释这些看似矛盾的发现呢？根据卡斯滕森（Carstensen，1987，1991）的研究，老年人通过寻求积极环境和回避消极环境来管理自己的情绪（Sanders，2010）。此外，由于他们曾历尽沧桑，故他们会以更加宽广的视角看待自己的经历。他们面对失望时会更加从容，更容易从个人批评中恢复过来，也更关注事情的积极方面。总体而言，大多数老年人对生活感到满意，并且能够享受很高的主观幸福感（Charles & Carstensen，2010）。
p64.en: Older persons also seem to benefit from their emotional systems, which in some respects become more sensitive to older age. A recent study found that older people feel more sad when watching tragic films than middle-aged and young people (Seider et al., 2010). However, older persons also feel more positive and less negative than younger people (Mroczek, 2001). How do we explain these seemingly contradictory discoveries? According to a study by Carstensen (1987, 1991), older persons manage their emotions by seeking positive and avoiding negative environments (Sanders, 2010). Moreover, because they have gone through a long time, they will look at their experiences with a broader perspective. They will be more tolerant in the face of disappointment, more likely to recover from individual criticism and more concerned with the positive aspects of the matter. Overall, most older persons are satisfied with their lives and enjoy a high degree of subjective well-being (Charles & Carstensen, 2010).

p65.original: 这些女士并不只是在一起喝咖啡——她们通过享受社交关系和人际互动来帮助自己活得更久、更健康。
p65.en: These women do not just drink coffee together — they help themselves to live longer and healthier lives by enjoying social relations and interpersonal interaction.

p66.original: 老年人是如何定义幸福（Well-being）的呢？通过一系列对中年人和老年人的访谈，赖芙（Ryff，1989）发现，男性和女性都会根据与他人的关系来定义幸福：他们努力成为有爱心的、富有同情心的人，并且重视拥有一个良好的社会支持网络。根据访谈，决定幸福的关键在于接受变化、享受生活和培养幽默感。
p66.en: How does the elderly define well-being? Through a series of interviews with middle-aged and elderly people, Ryff, 1989 found that both men and women define happiness in terms of their relationship with others: they strive to be caring, compassionate people and value having a good social support network. According to interviews, the key to determining happiness lies in accepting change, enjoying life and developing a sense of humor.

p68.original: 还有哪些策略可以有效应对年老化？老年人可以通过做社区志愿者、旅行、加入俱乐部和课程活动，或者与孙辈共度时光，来保持活力和与人亲近。很多研究支持了人们有与他人保持亲密关系的需要这一观点。这是你可以从本书中获得的最具实用价值的建议：任何将我们与社会支持源（由朋友和家人组成的可靠网络）分离开来的事物都会将我们置于风险之中，我们可能会因此患上身体疾病，出现心理问题，甚至出现社会病态行为。我们是社会生物，我们需要彼此的帮助和支持，这样才能保持效率和健康（Basic Behavioral Science Task Force，1996）。此外，我们也可以向其他文化学习，在那些文化中，老年人会因为智慧而获得尊重与崇敬。不过，在此之前，人们必须要克服“老年人无能为力”这种刻板印象（Brewer et al.，1981）。
p68.en: What other strategies can effectively respond to ageing? Older persons can stay alive and close to each other by volunteering in the community, travelling, joining clubs and courses, or spending time with their grandchildren. Many studies support the view that people need to remain in close relationships with others. This is the most practical suggestion you can get from this book: anything that separates us from the sources of social support (a reliable network of friends and family members) puts us at risk, and we may suffer from physical illness, psychological problems and even social pathologies. We are a social organism, and we need each other's help and support in order to maintain efficiency and health (Basic Behavioral Science Task Force, 1996). In addition, we can learn from other cultures where older persons gain respect and admiration for their wisdom. Before that, however, one had to overcome the stereotype of “elderless” (Brewer et al., 1981).

p69.original: 成功年老化——就像任何年龄段的成功一样——似乎需要尽可能获得最大收益并最大限度地减小损失造成的影响（Schulz & Heckhausen，1996）。此外，失去某些特定能力并不等于对个体自我感的威胁，认识到这一点对个人是非常有帮助的。当一个人的身体和心理资源发生变化时，他的目标也会发生变化（Carstensen & Freund，1994）。从这个角度来看，成年晚期是一个不断获得成就感的时期。研究人员亚瑟·斯通（Arthur Stone）说，如果你问中年人或更年长的人是否想回到25岁，你会发现没有几个人说想（Fields，2010）。
p69.en: Aging successfully — just as success at any age — seems to require maximizing benefits and minimizing the impact of losses (Schulz & Heckhausen, 1996). Moreover, the loss of certain specific capabilities does not amount to a threat to an individual's self-perception, which is very helpful to the individual. When a person's physical and psychological resources change, his goals change (Carstensen & Freund, 1994). From this perspective, the later age of adulthood is a period of continuous achievement. Researcher Arthur Stone said that if you asked whether middle-aged or older people wanted to return to age 25, you would find that few people (Filds, 2010) did.

p70.original: 心理学很有用 对吉姆双胞胎和你自己发展的回顾
p70.en: Psychology works. A review of Jim's twins and your own development.

p71.original: 既然你已经了解了人类毕生发展的一些关键要素，那么关于我们每个人为什么会发展成现在的样子，你能得出什么结论？现在，你对基因和环境的交互作用已经有了足够的了解，你知道两者都不能单独解释一个人的表现。在发展的不同阶段，两者共同发挥关键作用。但是你能将你学到的知识应用到你自己身上吗？首先，让我们试着解释一下吉姆双胞胎，我们在本章的开始部分介绍过他们。
p71.en: Now that you have learned some of the key elements of human development throughout your life, what can you conclude about why each of us has evolved into the present? Now you know enough about the interaction of genes and the environment, and you know that neither one can explain a person's performance alone. Together, they play a key role at different stages of development. But can you apply what you've learned to yourself? First, let's try to explain the Jim twins, which we introduced at the beginning of this chapter.

p72.original: 为了从更广阔的视角来理解这对双胞胎，你需要明白他们是“极端值”——在明尼苏达的双生子研究中他们是极端值，即使关于他们的报道非常多。虽然布沙尔和他的同事在双生子研究中发现，他们研究的所有双胞胎都存在很多出乎意料的发展上的相似性，但是大多数双胞胎并不像斯托和尤菲或者吉姆兄弟那么相似。而且，即使是布沙尔也承认，很多相似之处只是巧合（“The Mysteries，”1998）。虽然巧合之说不能提供一个令人信服的解释，但是其他解释似乎都很荒谬。例如，没有人会严肃地说，贝蒂和琳达这些名字已经写进了吉姆兄弟的基因，或者遗传规定要在手腕上戴一根橡皮筋。
p72.en: In order to understand these twins from a broader perspective, you need to understand that they are “extreme values” — they are extreme values in Minnesota's twin-child study, even though there are a lot of reports about them. Although Bouschall and his colleagues found in the twin-child study that all the twins they studied had many unexpected similarities in their development, most of the twins were not as similar as St. and Ufi or the Jim brothers. Moreover, even Bouchard admits that many of the similarities are coincidence (“The Mysteries,”). While coincidence does not provide a convincing explanation, other interpretations seem absurd. For example, no one would seriously say that the names Betty and Linda have been written into the Jim brothers' genes or that the genetic requirement is to wear a rubber band on their wrists.

p73.original: 真相可能没有那么戏剧化，但是却更加重要：同卵双胞胎确实有惊人的相似性，但是这些相似性主要体现在那些你可能预期到的特征上：智力、气质、手势、姿态和语速——所有这些特质都会受基因的影响。异卵双胞胎和其他兄弟姐妹也会表现出较弱的相似性，这一事实表明，遗传会对每一个人起作用，无论我们是否是双胞胎。布沙尔（1994）本人持一种非常极端的立场，认为遗传可以解释多达80%的同卵双胞胎身上观察到的相似性。批评者们对此表示怀疑。
p73.en: The truth may not be as dramatic as it is, but it is even more important: there are indeed striking similarities between identical twins, but these similarities are mainly in the characteristics that you may expect: intelligence, gas, gestures, postures, and speed of speech — all of which are influenced by genes. The fact that twins and other siblings also show weaker similarities shows that genetics can work for everyone, whether or not we are twins. Buchal (1994) himself has a very extreme position that genetics can explain the similarities observed in up to 80 per cent of identical twins. Critics have expressed doubts about this.

p74.original: 批评者们对布沙尔和其他双生子研究提出了哪些质疑？
p74.en: What are the questions of critics about Bouchard and the twin-child study?

p75.original: 他们指出，同卵双胞胎之间的相似性非常惊人，但是这种相似性也有环境的贡献。在世界上，没有一对双胞胎的行为是完全相同的。被一起抚养的双胞胎通常比被分开抚养的双胞胎的相似性更高，这一事实也为环境的作用提供了额外的支持证据。此外，随着年龄的增长，大多数双胞胎的个性会变得越来越不相似，这更加证明，除了遗传之外，环境也在持续影响个体的发展（McCartney et al.，1990）。
p75.en: They noted that the similarities between identical twins were alarming, but that they also contributed to the environment. In the world, no twin is acting exactly the same. The fact that a single-parent twin is usually more similar than a separated twin also provides additional evidence of the role of the environment. Moreover, with age, the personality of most twins will become increasingly different, which is further evidence that, in addition to genetics, the environment continues to affect individual development (McCartney et al., 1990).

p76.original: 我们还应该注意到，布沙尔研究中的很多双胞胎在被研究之前已经团聚一段时间了——环境很容易强化甚至创造出相似之处。确实如此，如奥斯卡·斯托和杰克·尤菲，这对被纳粹和犹太人分别抚养的双胞胎，也是先遇见彼此，直到5个月之后布沙尔才找到他们。事实上，心理学家利昂·卡民（Leon Kamin）说，布沙尔研究中的双胞胎有强烈的动机，夸大了他们的相似性并缩小他们间的不同之处，以取悦研究团队和吸引媒体关注（Horgan，1993）。（自从他们的故事在媒体上曝光之后，斯托和尤菲就雇了经纪人，并开始在电视上有偿露面，还把他们的故事卖给了好莱坞的电影制片人。）
p76.en: We should also note that many of the twins in the Bouchard study have been reunited for some time before they were studied — the environment is easy to strengthen and even create similarities. Indeed, as Oscar Stoll and Jack Yufi, the twins, who were raised by the Nazis and Jews respectively, met each other first and found them five months later in Bouchard. Indeed, according to the psychologist Leon Kamin, the twins in the Bouchar study had a strong motivation to exaggerate their similarities and reduce their differences in order to please the research team and attract media attention (Horgan, 1993). Since their stories were made public in the media, Sto and Yufi have hired brokers and started showing up on television, and sold their stories to Hollywood filmmakers. I don't think so.

p77.original: 批评者们指出的第三点是，因为同卵双胞胎长得像，所以人们常常以相似的方式来对待他们。这是一个可以解释很多行为间相似性的环境因素。例如，有吸引力的人通常会被人们认为更有趣和更友好，这反过来使得人们也会更友好地对待他们——这最终会导致与没有吸引力的人的不同后果。有吸引力的人会更加相似，不管他们是否一起长大。因此，由此产生的相似性可以归因于环境，就像可以归因于遗传一样。
p77.en: The third point pointed out by critics is that because the twins are similar, they are often treated in a similar way. This is an environmental factor that can explain the similarities between many behaviours. For example, attractive people are often perceived as more interesting and friendly, which in turn makes them more friendly — which ultimately leads to different consequences for unattractive people. The attractive people are more alike, whether or not they grow up together. Thus, the resulting similarities can be attributed to the environment, as can be attributed to genetics.

p78.original: 最后，批评者们提醒我们，在这类研究中科学家们的希望和预期会影响他们的研究结果。因为布沙尔和同卵双胞胎的其他研究人员期望找到遗传的影响，他们的注意力将会被相似性吸引而不是差异性。事实上，大多数人相遇时都是这样做的：他们的谈话从一个话题跳到另一个话题，直到他们找到相同的兴趣、态度、经历或活动。
p78.en: Finally, critics remind us that the hopes and expectations of scientists in such research will influence their findings. Because Bouchard and other researchers with identical twins expect to find genetic effects, their attention will be drawn to similarities rather than differences. In fact, most of them met when they jumped from one topic to another until they found the same interest, attitude, experience or activity.

p79.original: 那么，关于双生子研究和遗传与环境的作用是否存在共通之处呢？布沙尔和他的批评者都同意，遗传或环境并不能单独促成行为和心理过程。它们一直在交互作用。因此，从发展的角度来看，遗传和环境共同作用，塑造了一个人的一生——以我们在本章中提到的所有方式。
p79.en: So, is there a correlation between twin-child research and the role of genetics and the environment? Both Bouchar and his critics agree that genetic or environmental conditions do not alone contribute to behavioural and psychological processes. They've been interacting. Thus, from a development perspective, genetics and the environment work together to shape a lifetime — in all the ways we have mentioned in this chapter.

p80.original: 批判性思维的应用：莫扎特效应
p80.en: Application of critical thinking: the Mozart effect

p81.original: 给胎儿或新生儿播放古典音乐，真的可以提高他们的智商吗？
p81.en: Can the performance of classical music to the foetus or the newborn really improve their IQ?

p82.original: 想象一下：你刚刚有了你的第一个孩子，你觉得非常骄傲，因为你深信他是世界上最棒的孩子（我们不是在取笑你，每一个人都是这样看待自己的孩子的）。像很多父母一样，你希望为你的孩子提供一切机会，来帮助他发挥他的全部潜能。因此，如果你听说听莫扎特的音乐可以让你的孩子更聪明，你会如何做？1993年，一对科学家宣布了这一爆炸性的发现，听莫扎特的音乐确实可以提升智商分数（Rauscher et al.，1993）。这项研究获得了媒体的广泛报道，并且催生了一系列创新举动。至少在美国有两个州的州长下令，为每名新生儿提供一张莫扎特CD；出售各种相关音乐的网站应运而生，并且都承诺可以改变听众的“健康、教育和幸福”；准妈妈们开始把耳机放在肚子上给她们未出生的孩子播放莫扎特的音乐。不过，在加入这股潮流之前，我们不妨对这个奇异的说法进行一些批判性思考。
p82.en: Imagine: You've just had your first child, and you're very proud because you believe he's the best child in the world. (We're not making fun of you, that's how everyone sees his child.) Like many parents, you want to give your child every chance to help him realize his full potential. So, if you heard that Mozart's music could make your kids smarter, what would you do? In 1993, a couple of scientists announced this explosive discovery, and it is true that Mozart's music can raise IQ scores (Rauscher et al., 1993). The study received extensive media coverage and led to a series of innovative initiatives. At least two states in the United States have been ordered by the Governor to provide each newborn with a Mozart CD; A website that sells all the relevant music has been created, and there is a commitment to change the “health, education and well-being” of the audience; Mothers began to put headphones on their stomachs to play Mozart music for their unborn children. However, before joining the tide, we may wish to make some critical reflections on this strange assertion.

p84.original: 听莫扎特的音乐真的能提高智商吗？如果这项研究是可靠的，那么这项新发现与其他考察音乐作用以及提升智力的研究成果相一致吗？其他类型的音乐——古典音乐或其他——能发挥类似的作用吗？最后，如果听某种类型的音乐确实提高了智商，我们能确定是音乐本身提高了智商，还是听音乐时的某些体验促进了智商的提高呢？这只是一名优秀的批判性思考者在第一次听到这个奇异的说法时，可能会提出的几个问题。
p84.en: Can Mozart really improve his IQ? If the study is reliable, is the new finding consistent with other studies that examine the role of music and enhance intelligence? Can other types of music — classical music or other — play a similar role? Finally, if listening to some type of music does improve IQ, can we be sure that music itself improves IQ, or that certain experiences when listening to music contribute to IQ improvement? This is just a few questions that might have been raised by a good critical thinker when he first heard this strange statement.

p85.original: 超凡的说法需要超凡的证据
p85.en: The paranormal claim requires extraordinary evidence.

p86.original: 你首先会想到的可能是这个说法的极端性：最初的研究报告说，听10分钟的莫扎特音乐就可以将智商分数提升8分到9分！是否有超凡的证据支持这个超凡的说法呢？来源分析显示，这个说法来自一所受人尊敬的大学的研究人员，这使得这个说法具备了一定的可信度。那么，这项证据的本质是什么？首先，这一发现确实是基于实证研究而不是传闻逸事，因此它通过了考验。这项证据有待检查的第二个元素是样本：被试是谁，他们在多大程度上能代表整个群体？在这项研究中，被试是大学生，这可能会让你觉得有所怀疑。这些发现能够应用到婴儿身上吗？或者这一效应是否只局限在已经具备某种认知发展水平的群体？
p86.en: What you might think first of all is the extreme nature of this: the original study said that listening to 10 minutes of Mozart would raise the IQ score by 8 to 9 points! Is there any extraordinary evidence to support this superstition? The source analysis shows that this statement comes from a respected university researcher, which gives it some credibility. So, what is the essence of this evidence? First of all, the discovery was indeed based on empirical research rather than on hearsay, and it passed the test. The second element of this evidence to be examined is the sample: who was tried and to what extent can they represent the whole group? In this study, the test is for university students, which may give you some doubt. Can these things be applied to babies? Or is this effect confined to those groups that already have a certain level of cognitive development?

p87.original: 推理过程是否避免了逻辑错误
p87.en: Whether the reasoning process avoids a logical error

p88.original: 一种常见的逻辑错误是相关-因果（correlation-causation）推论。在本研究中，研究人员使用了随机分组的实验设计，因此这些发现在本质上是一种因果关系，而非相关关系。然而，即使一项研究的发现是可靠的，如果研究人员过度简化或夸大研究发现的意义，也会产生谬误。在这种情况下，从该研究的发现得出听莫扎特的音乐可以提升智商这一结论是合理的吗？
p88.en: A common logical error is the associated-cause-causal inference. In the present study, researchers have used randomly grouped experimental designs, so these findings are essentially causal rather than related. However, even if the findings of a study were reliable, it would be a mistake to oversimplify or exaggerate the significance of the findings of the study. In this context, is it reasonable to draw the conclusion from the findings of the study that listening to Mozart's music can boost IQs?

p89.original: 真正有趣的是：如果仔细看这些结果，你会发现，该研究中智商的提升只是暂时性的，15分钟之后就消失了。其次，用于测量智商的测验（根据定义应该是一项全面的测试）实际上只是视觉-空间能力测试（它只是智商测验的一个特定部分）。听莫扎特的音乐提升了智力，显然是对实际发现的一种夸大。
p89.en: And what's really interesting is that if you look at these results carefully, you'll find that the IQ upgrade in the study is only temporary and disappears in 15 minutes. Second, the tests used to measure IQ (which by definition should be a comprehensive test) are actually only visual-space capability tests (which are only a specific part of IQ tests). Listening to Mozart's music has boosted intelligence, apparently exaggerating the actual discovery.

p90.original: 我们能够得出什么结论

p91.original: 之后几年，已经有超过20项类似的研究完成并将成果发表在公认的科学期刊上。虽然少数研究发现了众所周知的“莫扎特效应”，但是大多数研究没有发现这一效应（Steele et al.，1999）。事实上，对这一过程的深入研究揭示出，智商分数的短暂提升更确切地说是积极的心境轻微提升的结果，大多数被试在聆听研究中使用的莫扎特乐曲时，报告自己体会到了积极的心境：对听音乐前和听音乐后的心境进行测量，并在统计中剔除心境的作用之后，短暂的智商提升消失了（Thompson et al.，2001）。更重要的是，其他温和的积极体验，如聆听故事而不是静坐10分钟，也能产生同样的心境提升，随后也会产生智商分数的短暂提升（Nantais & Schellenberg，1999）。
p91.en: In the following years, more than 20 similar studies have been completed and their results published in recognized scientific journals. While a few studies have found the well-known “Mozat effect”, most studies have not found it (Steele et al., 1999). Indeed, an in-depth study of the process reveals that the short increase in IQ scores is more precisely the result of a slight increase in the positive heart, most of which was tried to hear the Mozart music used in the study, and reported that it had a positive heart: a measurement of the heart before and after listening to the music, and a brief increase in IQ disappeared after the impact of dissociating the heart from the statistics (Thompson et al., 2001). More importantly, other moderate positive experiences, such as listening to stories rather than sitting for 10 minutes, can generate the same level of heart gain, followed by a short increase in IQ scores (Nantais & Schellenberg, 1999).

p92.original: 这些研究的一个更合理的结论是：那些增加积极心境的经历会提高视觉-空间推理能力。与“莫扎特效应”相反，这一发现得到了其他心理学研究的证实。例如，一些研究揭示，积极的心境和认知任务的绩效之间存在相关关系（Ashby et al.，1999；Kenealy，1997）。并且听令人愉悦的音乐，可以提高个体完成各项任务的速度和总体表现。
p92.en: A more reasonable conclusion of these studies is that experiences that increase positive hearts enhance visual-space reasoning. Contrary to the “Mozat effect”, this finding was confirmed by other psychological studies. For example, some studies have revealed a correlation between positive heart and cognitive mission performance (Ashby et al., 1999); Kenyaly, 1997. And listening to the joyful music can increase the speed and overall performance of individual tasks.

p93.original: 公平地说，并不是最初的研究报告夸大了研究发现，或者暗示研究结果可以应用于婴儿，而是研究发表之后激增的媒体报道导致了这一结果。斯坦福大学的奇普·希思（Chip Heath）教授认为，他知道原因：1993年的那篇文章发表之后，它在报纸上获得的关注远大于同时期的其他文章，在学生成绩最差的州获得的关注最多。希思说，“问题引导人们去寻找解决方案”，并且和世界上其他文化相比，美国文化特别关注儿童早期教育（Krakovsky，2005）。
p93.en: To be fair, it is not the initial study that exaggerates the findings of the study, or suggests that the findings can be applied to infants, but rather the surge in media coverage since the publication of the study has led to this result. According to Professor Chip Heath of Stanford University, he knew the reason: after the article published in 1993, it received far more attention in the newspapers than in other articles of the same period, and the greatest attention was given in the states with the worst student performance. Heath said that “problems lead people to find solutions” and that American culture devotes special attention to early childhood education compared to other cultures in the world (Krakovsky, 2005).

p94.original: 希思指出，焦虑会导致情感偏差（emotional bias），这种偏差会让人们去寻找看似简单又容易取得丰硕成果的解决办法。此外，记忆研究表明，故事的细节会随着传播被扭曲——你能想象有多少人读了报纸上的那篇文章吗（那篇文章很可能已经歪曲了原始发现）？然后他们再告诉一个朋友，然后朋友又会告诉朋友，以此类推，在这个传播过程中故事已经变成什么样子了？这就难怪“莫扎特效应”这一神话在我们的文化中占据了如此重要的地位。最后，证实性偏差可以帮助我们理解，为什么人们依然坚信“莫扎特效应”是真实存在的，尽管研究报告和报纸上的文章都已经驳斥了它。
p94.en: Heath pointed out that anxiety can lead to emotional bias (among others), which can lead people to find solutions that seem simple and that can easily yield fruitful results. Moreover, memory studies show that the story details are distorted with the spread — can you imagine how many people have read the article in the paper (which is probably already distorted by the original discovery)? And then they tell a friend, and then friends tell a friend, and with that push, what has happened to the story in the process? That explains why the myth of the “Morzat effect” is so important in our culture. Finally, confirmation bias can help us understand why the “Mozat effect” remains firmly believed to be real, despite the fact that it has been refuted in studies and newspaper articles.
